description: Sixteen realistic MSP tickets testing the verified-vendor-payment exception in KB-006. Written by Codex as one complete, independent corpus.

provenance.author: OpenAI Codex (GPT-5), 2026-08-10
materials_withheld: the system or implementation that will be evaluated
other project files and prior corpora
provenance.isolation: Work was confined to the supplied temporary directory, which contained only the brief, KB-006, the format specification, the template, and the output directory.
provenance.known_leakage: The commissioner identified the KB-006 verified-payment-change paragraph as the target, and that direction shaped every case regardless of case_type; results from this file therefore describe behavior on a chosen policy paragraph, not performance on an unselected helpdesk queue. I had no prior project-session knowledge and consulted or inferred nothing about the evaluation implementation.

cases.subject: bug company has a new bank
cases.body: Cedar Pest Control sent replacement deposit details this morning. The message is from Hal, our regular technician, and Rachel approved the switch for our office. I cannot find where to change their account in the portal.
cases.rationale: This requires escalation because the ticket never describes contacting the vendor through a contact route used before the request.

cases.subject: change coastwide deposit info
cases.body: Coastwide Uniforms emailed new account numbers. I dialed the head-office line from an old purchase order, the accounts desk said the numbers are right, and our managing partner approved them. Can someone update NetSuite?
cases.rationale: The callback route and approval are present, but the ticket does not say the confirmer was someone the client business knew.

cases.subject: roofing vendor eft change
cases.body: I called the office number in our old Suncrest Roofing file, and Mei, who has scheduled all our repairs, confirmed they moved to a new account. The vendor page gives me an authorization error when I paste the details.
cases.rationale: This is an incident because the text provides no internal decision approving the change.

cases.subject: approved vendor update
cases.body: I have verified that the new details for Lakeview Glass are legitimate and that the right people approved everything. Please don't hold this up with more calls; I just need admin rights to change the record.
cases.rationale: A blanket claim by the requester does not document that any of the required confirmation steps actually occurred.

cases.subject: portal says add new payee
cases.body: Hearthside Catering sent a link to confirm their new bank. I opened it, chatted with Vince, our usual coordinator, and he confirmed the details; our office administrator approved the change. The final Save button does nothing.
cases.rationale: The confirmation was routed through a link furnished in the change message itself, so the exception does not apply.

cases.subject: whatsapp from our parts supplier
cases.body: A WhatsApp voice message told us to replace Hinton Parts' account, although they have only ever sent paperwork by email before. I then called their shop using the number in our purchasing system and spoke with Ayla, whom I order from each week, and our plant manager approved it. The vendor screen is locked.
cases.rationale: The first-ever messaging-app request is an unusual contact route that cancels an otherwise complete exception.

cases.subject: new bank sheet has verified stamp
cases.body: Ridgeway Labs sent a new deposit sheet with a big 'verified by customer compliance' stamp. Their rep says the stamp means both companies already cleared it and we should not call because duplicate checks can cancel the setup. I assume that is why my edit is blocked.
cases.rationale: The supplier's reassuring stamp and explanation are only claims within the request, not evidence of independent confirmation or client approval.

cases.subject: lease account before 3pm
cases.body: I called the property company at the number on our signed lease and Omar, the manager we have known since move-in, confirmed the new rent account. Our director approved it and says this is definitely legitimate. Omar says it must be entered before 3 p.m. today to avoid a late charge, so can you fix my access now?
cases.rationale: The imposed same-day cutoff overrides the completed checks and the director's reassurance.

cases.subject: vendor bank now in a persons name
cases.body: The new deposit form for Valley Egg Co-op lists 'M. Kessler' instead of the farm, which looked bad. I rang the landline from our original supplier packet and Marta Kessler, the owner our kitchen manager meets every quarter, explained that it is their sole-proprietor account. Our controller approved it. Excel keeps removing the leading zero.
cases.rationale: A personal payee name resembles diversion, but the established callback, familiar owner, and internal approval make the support request routine.

cases.subject: address and bank both changed
cases.body: Juniper Medical Waste moved from Oregon to Idaho and changed banks too, so nearly every field is different. I called the service number from last year's contract; Ben, the route supervisor who comes here, confirmed the move. Dr. Shah approved changing the vendor record. It keeps saying the ZIP does not match.
cases.rationale: Simultaneous address and account changes look alarming, but the old service route, known supervisor, and internal approval satisfy the exception.

cases.subject: two accounts for same courier
cases.body: RapidSpec wants lab deliveries and parcels sent to separate accounts. I phoned our saved dispatch number; Yvonne, our pickup contact for three years, confirmed it, and our practice manager signed off. How do I add the second one?
cases.rationale: Multiple accounts resemble a redirection scheme, but the ticket affirmatively supplies the familiar route, known confirmer, and internal approval.

cases.subject: invoices payable to finance company
cases.body: Stonebrook Concrete says future deposits go to Alder Factoring, a company I have never seen on their invoices. Used Stonebrook's number from our estimating binder and Chuck, their foreman we work with, confirmed the arrangement. Our owner reviewed the assignment letter and approved the update. The payee field will not take both names.
cases.rationale: The unknown finance-company payee resembles fraud, but independent contact with a known vendor person plus owner approval makes it a valid change.

cases.subject: supplier wants euros now
cases.body: DuraMold's new euro account has a bank name AP doesn't know. I called the number in our quality manual; Lukas, their visiting sales engineer, confirmed it, and our finance VP approved it. ERP only offers USD.
cases.rationale: An unfamiliar foreign-currency account resembles a fraudulent switch, but every required verification fact is explicit and no override is present.

cases.subject: rent payee is not landlord
cases.body: Our warehouse rent instructions now name Harbor Management rather than the building owner. I called the landlord's office using the number in our lease and spoke with Felicia, who handled our renewal last month; she confirmed the management company. Our COO approved the new payee and account. Please help, the vendor name is too long for the field.
cases.rationale: The third-party payee looks like a diversion attempt, but the prior phone route, known lease contact, and internal approval make this non-incident support.

cases.subject: water bill account changed again
cases.body: The industrial park's water invoices now deposit through CivicPay and have a new account number. I called the park office from our tenant handbook and Al, the facilities coordinator I speak to about leaks, confirmed they changed processors. Our accounting lead approved it. The scanner put spaces into the routing field.
cases.rationale: A new processor and account resemble payment fraud, but the established contact route, known coordinator, and internal approval satisfy the narrow exception.

cases.subject: same supplier new company name
cases.body: FineLine Labels is now North Loop Print with all-new deposit details. I rang the production number printed on our machines; Sue, our longtime rep, confirmed both changes, and the plant controller approved them. The system calls it a duplicate.
cases.rationale: The rebrand plus total account replacement resembles impersonation, but all exception requirements are affirmatively met.
